# isoplane doctor

Check this machine, or validate a WebAssembly module.

```bash
isoplane doctor [module] [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `module` | WebAssembly module to validate; without one, checks this machine. |

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--guest-memory-bytes <guest-memory-bytes>` | Guest memory ceiling in bytes. |
| `--json` | Write machine-readable JSON. |
